name: vibe-verifier-coverage-not-lost
description: The pinned toolchain for the coverage-not-lost gate on Vitest: @vitest/coverage-v8 at each Vitest version it measures with when the project has no provider of its own, each under the alias coverage-v8-<version>. A provider runs only under a Vitest of exactly its version, and the Vitest that runs is always the project's own.
